description: The world's record of what has been found living where, from GBIF, the Global Biodiversity Information Facility. Billions of observations and museum specimens, pooled from thousands of institutions in almost every country, and free to everyone. Check a scientific name against GBIF's own list to catch typos and replace out-of-date names with current ones, then find where that species has actually been recorded - by country, by date, by kind of evidence, or only the sightings that come with a photograph. Count matching records without fetching them when all you need is whether anything is there. Every record carries what was found, where, when, who found it, and which dataset it came from, so you can follow any of it back to the museum or survey that stands behind it. No account or API key required.
